messages:
maria: heads up — onboarding sample app is printing raw Authorization headers in DEBUG logs when retries kick in.
kevin: ugh. which sample? py or node?
maria: python sample (sampleapp-python). happens when the retry middleware retries auth and logs the outgoing request. only shows up in DEBUG.
zoe: can you paste the log line?
maria: sure:

DEBUG http.client: Sending request POST /v1/generate Authorization: Bearer sk-xxx...123

sam: that looks like our loghook redaction didn't run before the http client emitted the headers. order-of-init issue? :thinking_face: 
kevin: we recently moved OpenTelemetry init earlier to capture traces. might have bumped the logging-hook registration to after requests lib.
zoe: yep — if otel SDK wraps requests first, the requests lib will log before our redact hook sees it.
maria: repro steps I used:
1) pip install -r requirements.txt
2) export LOG_LEVEL=DEBUG
3) run `python sample.py` and trigger a call that errors once so retry happens
4) note header leak in logs

kevin: thanks. quick fix would be to ensure our logging hook is registered as early as possible, before any import that triggers requests sessions.
sam: alternative: add a redact-on-emission layer in the log formatter too, so even if a lib logs raw headers, we scrub in the Formatter.
zoe: +1 for defensive formatter. but need both for full coverage.
maria: another related quirk — request ids aren't preserved across async retries in the JS sample app. node sets `x-request-id` on initial attempt but retry middleware makes new request without copying the header.
kevin: that's bad for tracing. is the middleware creating a fresh headers object?
maria: looks like it clones and doesn't merge existing headers. minimal patch: if headers['x-request-id'] missing, copy from ctx.requestId or reuse original headers.
sam: can we add an OpenTelemetry attribute for request_id to traces so console can correlate even if header gets dropped?
zoe: telemetry-bot note: otel spans currently capture `http.request_id` only if header present at span start. if retry creates new span we need to propagate the attribute from parent context.
telemetry-bot: automated note — trace 0a1b2c shows span start without `http.request_id` but parent has attribute. recommend propagating during retry.
kevin: plan: 1) maria files quick PR to add formatter-level redaction + move logging hook registration earlier in python sample. 2) sam to open an RFC for formatter redaction across SDKs. 3) zoe to add retry propagation test in node sample.
maria: I'll draft PR with failing test attached. will also include log snippet in description.
sam: for the RFC include a table of sensitive header keys (authorization, cookie, set-cookie) and token patterns so other teams can opt-in.
kevin: timeline?
zoe: aiming for small fixes by end of sprint, RFC next week.
maria: thanks — will @kevin on the PR once ready.
kevin: nice, thanks. :thumbsup:
sam: also add a quick note in onboarding doc about setting LOG_LEVEL=INFO for initial run to avoid scary token-looking logs for new users.
maria: good call — I'll update the README.
zoe: ack. updating sampleapp checklist too.
telemetry-bot: deploy-checklist updated (sampleapp-python): moved logging-hook earlier, added formatter redaction TODO.
